verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance has a public OpenAPI-documented v3 API with OAuth client-credentials for server-to-server integrations. The product itself monitors entity statuses and sends annual report reminders, and shows due dates and filing status. However, the evidence never shows API endpoints that expose entity standing or filing deadlines (only registered-agent-deliveries endpoints are confirmed), and no webhooks are documented, so an agent watching deadlines programmatically is only weakly supported. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for entity status and filing due dates, registrable webhooks or event callbacks for upcoming or lapsed deadlines, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven monitoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse
